rows.scenario: Baseline: label decoded with the issuer's registry entry and contexts
Signed label after a routine vocabulary update (one term added under the same URL)
rows.outcome: label UNREADABLE: decode error "Improperly formatted bytes "122,173,28,166,94,175,38,44,87,128,76,179," — the reason (codec drift) is not reported; the label stays unusable for its lifetime

rows.scenario: Compact profile signing the CBOR-LD bytes, after the same update
rows.outcome: signature valid: true; meaning changed silently (access scope changed)

rows.scenario: Registry entry substituted at the verifier (context codes swapped)
rows.outcome: decode error: Unknown term ID "180" was detected in the CBOR-LD input.

rows.scenario: M15 bound envelope; verifier's context was updated; no archive
rows.outcome: rejected before decoding: codec manifest mismatch: local registry entry or its contexts differ from the issuer's, and no archived manifest was found

rows.scenario: M15 bound envelope + lifetime archive of the issuer's manifest
rows.outcome: decoded from lifetime archive (resolved by manifest digest); proof valid: true

rows.scenario: M15 bound envelope; registry entry substituted at the verifier
rows.outcome: rejected before decoding: codec manifest mismatch: local registry entry or its contexts differ from the issuer's, and no archived manifest was found
